package config

import "fmt"

// Load parses the configuration and validates each section.
func Load(cfg *Config, source string) (*Config, error) {
	if err := cfg.Deliberation.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing %s: %w", source, err)
	}
	if err := cfg.Batches.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing %s: %w", source, err)
	}
	return cfg, nil
}
